ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:2.original: W-Why? What's the meaning of this? The Atelier Ranking System is being temporarily suspended? ... Eeehhh?!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:2.translation: П-почему? Что это значит? Система рангов ателье временно приостанавливается? ... Ээээээ?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:3.original: W-What's going on? What all this noise?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:3.translation: Ч-что происходит? Что это за шум?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:4.original: Ah, Mireille! This! What's the meaning of this?!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:4.translation: Ах, Мирей! Вот это! Что это значит?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:5.original: Ah. I told you how the ranking system was created to help defeat Falgior, didn't I?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:5.translation: Ах. Я ведь рассказывала вам, что система рангов была создана, чтобы помочь победить Фальгиора, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:6.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:6.original: Now we've done that, we're a little unsure what we're going to do with it.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:6.translation: Теперь, когда мы с этим справились, мы немного не уверены, что с ней делать дальше.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:7.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:7.original: So there will be a little break in promotion exams! Hehehe!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:7.translation: Так что в экзаменах на повышение будет небольшой перерыв! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:10.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:10.original: H-Hold on? I thought they might appreciate a bit of time off...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:10.translation: П-погодите? Я думала, они оценят небольшой отдых...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:11.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:11.original: Wow, they actually looked really depressed. Hmm, what can I do to cheer them up?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_010.ebm:11.translation: Ого, они и правда выглядят очень подавленными. Хм, чем бы их подбодрить?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:1.original: Hey, Dad's not here? He's not off wasting our money again, is he?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:1.translation: Эй, а папы нет? Он же снова не ушёл транжирить наши деньги?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:2.original: What! Not again! We've hardly got any money left this month already!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:2.translation: Что?! Только не снова! В этом месяце у нас и так почти не осталось денег!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:3.original: Then we just need to make some more! Make enough to cover everything he might spend!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:3.translation: Тогда просто заработаем ещё! Хватит, чтобы покрыть всё, что он только ни потратит!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:4.original: Yeah. There wasn't much on the Notice Board, but maybe we can find something in the city?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:4.translation: Ага. На доске объявлений почти ничего нет, но может, в городе найдём что-нибудь?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:5.original: Good thought! Right, time to go find some money!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_020.ebm:5.translation: Хорошая мысль! Ладно, пора искать деньги!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:0.speaker: Woman A
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:0.original: It's the hero twins! Awww, they're so cute!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:1.speaker: Woman B
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:1.original: Look, you're right! I just want to pet them on the head!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:1.translation: Смотри, и правда! Так и хочется потрепать их по головке!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:3.original: That makes me so happy! Actually, we're looking for some work...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:3.translation: Так приятно это слышать! Вообще-то мы ищем работу...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:4.original: Is there anything we can help you with? We'll do whatever you need!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:4.translation: Можем чем-нибудь вам помочь? Сделаем всё, что нужно!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:5.speaker: Woman B
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:5.original: Let me see. Anything you can think of?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:5.translation: Дай подумать. У тебя есть идеи?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:6.speaker: Woman A
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:6.original: Hmm, the storms have stopped, and there are less monsters now too. Sorry, I don't think I really need anything...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:6.translation: Хм, бури прекратились, и монстров стало меньше. Простите, кажется, мне ничего не нужно...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:7.original: No problem. Thanks for your time, anyway!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:7.translation: Ничего страшного. Всё равно спасибо, что уделили время!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:8.speaker: Woman A
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:8.original: Those two are really lovely, aren't they?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:8.translation: Эти двое и правда прелестны, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:9.speaker: Woman B
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:9.original: I was thinking the same thing! Hehe, I'm becoming quite a fan!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_030.ebm:9.translation: Я как раз о том же думала! Хе-хе, я прямо их фанатка!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:0.original: Ahem! Everyone! Do you have any work for us? We'll do anything you need!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:0.translation: Кхм! Всем внимание! Есть для нас работа? Сделаем всё, что нужно!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:1.speaker: unknown(name_id=31)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:1.original: Hey, it's the twins! Can I get an autograph?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:2.speaker: unknown(name_id=36)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:2.original: Hey, me too! Tell us about the fight with Falgior!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:2.translation: Эй, и мне! Расскажите про бой с Фальгиором!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:3.original: A-Autographs? About Falgior? Hey, hold on. Stop pushing!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:3.translation: А-автографы? Про Фальгиора? Эй, погодите. Не толкайтесь!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:4.speaker: unknown(name_id=36)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:4.original: That was quite a fight with Falgior, wasn't it! Thanks for telling me all about it!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:4.translation: Ну и битва с Фальгиором была! Спасибо, что всё рассказали!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:5.speaker: unknown(name_id=31)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:5.original: I'll treasure this autograph forever! Keep it up, hero twins!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:5.translation: Этот автограф я буду хранить вечно! Так держать, близняшки-героини!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:6.original: Wow, that was quite the surprise!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:7.original: They both seemed very happy, though. It's nice to have everyone supporting us, isn't it?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_040.ebm:7.translation: Хотя оба выглядели очень довольными. Приятно, что все нас поддерживают, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:0.original: Hello there! We're looking for some work...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:1.speaker: Old Woman
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:1.original: Oh, hello dears. Thank you so much for defeating the Thunder God.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:1.translation: О, здравствуйте, милые. Огромное спасибо, что победили Бога Грома.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:2.speaker: Old Woman
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:2.original: It isn't much, but here's a little something from me. Buy yourselves something nice.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:2.translation: Это немного, но вот вам от меня. Купите себе что-нибудь вкусненькое.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:3.original: What? Really? Thank you so much! Are you sure?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:3.translation: Что? Правда? Большое спасибо! Вы уверены?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:4.speaker: Old Woman
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:4.original: Yes, I'm sure. Get some sugar in you, cutie.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:6.original: Wow, are you sure about this?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:6.translation: Ого, а ей точно можно было принимать?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:7.original: It would have been ruder to turn her down. Let's just make sure we put it to good use.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:7.translation: Отказать было бы грубее. Давай просто распорядимся этим с толком.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:8.original: I guess so. We still didn't get any work though, did we?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_050.ebm:8.translation: Наверное, да. Но работу мы так и не нашли, да?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:0.original: Huh. We didn't find any work, in the end.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:0.translation: Хм. В итоге работы мы так и не нашли.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:1.original: I know. Dad is probably home by now. Let's just go back to the atelier.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:1.translation: Знаю. Папа, наверное, уже дома. Давай просто вернёмся в ателье.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:2.original: You're right. Dad, please! Just don't buy anything too crazy!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_060.ebm:2.translation: Ты права. Папа, пожалуйста! Только не покупай ничего совсем сумасшедшего!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:0.original: We're back! Huh? Dad still isn't here?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:0.translation: Мы вернулись! Хм? Папы всё ещё нет?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:1.original: Looks like it. This is odd... He always comes back home when he's hungry...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:1.translation: Похоже на то. Странно... Он всегда возвращается домой, когда проголодается...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:2.original: Ah, finally! Hey! Where have you been?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:2.translation: Ах, наконец-то! Эй! Где ты была?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:3.original: Excuse me? I was just shopping in the city?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:3.translation: Прошу прощения? Я просто ходила по магазинам в городе?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:4.original: Sophie! Ah, sorry, that wasn't directed at you! We're waiting for our dad to come back, actually.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:4.translation: Софи! Ой, извини, это было не тебе! Мы как раз ждём, когда вернётся папа.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:5.original: Sorry about that. We weren't expecting you, Sophie.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:5.translation: Прости. Мы тебя не ждали, Софи.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:6.original: Hahaha, don't mind me. I should apologize for just turning up like this.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:6.translation: Ха-ха-ха, не обращай внимания. Это мне стоит извиниться, что явилась без предупреждения.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:7.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:7.original: I heard you were looking for work, so there's something I wanted to ask you.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:7.translation: Я слышала, вы ищете работу, так что хотела вас кое о чём попросить.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:8.original: A job from you, S-Sophie? This is going to be depressingly difficult, isn't it!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:8.translation: Работа от тебя, С-Софи? Это будет удручающе сложно, да?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:9.original: I wouldn't say depressing! I'm going to be here for a while, so I'm settling in.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:9.translation: Я бы не сказала, что удручающе! Я тут на какое-то время, так что обживаюсь.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:10.original: I'd like you to make some useful items for me.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:10.translation: Хотела бы, чтобы вы сделали для меня несколько полезных вещей.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:11.original: Hmm, OK. I think we can handle this.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:12.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:12.original: Hahaha, great. Will you bring them to me once you're done?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:12.translation: Ха-ха-ха, отлично. Принесёте их мне, когда закончите?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:13.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:13.original: If you need to go and collect materials, I'll help. Thanks for this!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:13.translation: Если нужно будет собрать материалы, я помогу. Спасибо!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:14.original: Sophie could easily make this herself. She wanted to give us some work.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:14.translation: Софи легко могла бы сделать это сама. Она хотела дать нам работу.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:15.original: Looks like it. She's really done so much for us, hasn't she?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:15.translation: Похоже на то. Она столько для нас сделала, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:16.original: Right then! We can't let her down. Let's synth up some items that'll knock Sophie's socks off!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_070.ebm:16.translation: Ну тогда! Нельзя её подвести. Давай синтезируем вещи, от которых у Софи челюсть отвиснет!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:1.original: Heheh. I'm glad we could help.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:2.original: Here's your payment. Great work, girls.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:2.translation: Вот ваша плата. Отличная работа, девочки.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:3.original: Hey, Lydie, Sue! You're here to see my teacher?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:3.translation: Привет, Лиди, Сью! Вы к моей учительнице?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:4.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:4.original: Kind of. I asked them to do some work for me. They really helped me out.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:4.translation: Вроде того. Я попросила их кое-что сделать. Они здорово меня выручили.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:5.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:5.original: Indeed. The two of them are quite skilled. Definitely students worthy of Ilmeria.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:5.translation: Действительно. Обе довольно искусны. Определённо ученицы, достойные Ильмерии.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:6.original: Wow. A compliment from Plachta! That should be a real confidence booster!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:6.translation: Ого. Комплимент от Плахты! Это должно здорово прибавить уверенности!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:7.original: After all, Plachta is Miss Sophie's teacher!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:8.original: What? She is? I thought she was Sophie's student!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:8.translation: Что? Она?! Я думала, она ученица Софи!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:9.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:9.original: People often make that mistake, but I'm the mentor here. Sophie hasn't overtaken me yet.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:9.translation: Люди часто так ошибаются, но наставница здесь я. Софи меня ещё не обогнала.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:10.original: Really? I think I've got some moves of my own by now!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:10.translation: Правда? Думаю, у меня уже есть несколько собственных козырей!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:11.original: Wow, the sparks are really flying! That's the kind of student-teacher relationship I long for!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:11.translation: Ого, искры так и сыплются! Вот таких отношений ученицы и учительницы я так хочу!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:12.original: Me too! We'll be just like that with Ilmeria one day, I bet!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:12.translation: И я! Держу пари, однажды у нас с Ильмерией будет то же самое!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:13.original: Hey, we'd better get back to the atelier. I think we've overstayed our welcome already!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:13.translation: Эй, нам лучше вернуться в ателье. Кажется, мы уже засиделись!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:14.original: Good point. We'll see you later!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:15.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:15.original: Very well. Take care on your way home. We don't want you falling and getting hurt.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_080.ebm:15.translation: Хорошо. Будьте осторожны по дороге домой. Не хотелось бы, чтобы вы упали и ушиблись.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:1.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:1.original: Welcome home! Would you like... me? Or me? Or perhaps... me?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:1.translation: С возвращением! Хотите... меня? Или меня? А может... меня?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:2.original: M-Mireille? Hold on. I thought we locked up before we left?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:2.translation: М-Мирей? Погоди. Я думала, мы закрыли дверь, когда уходили?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:3.original: Hehe, just who do you think I am? I have the authority of the state at my beck and call!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:3.translation: Хе-хе, а кем я, по-вашему, являюсь? У меня за спиной вся власть государства!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:4.original: That actually sounds a bit scary!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:5.original: Anyway, forget the small stuff. I'm here with an exciting offer for you both.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:5.translation: В общем, забудьте о мелочах. Я здесь с захватывающим предложением для вас обеих.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:6.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:6.original: Tell me, twins. How would you feel about a vacation?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:9.original: You mean a tropical island, swimming in the clear seas, eating fresh fruit...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:9.translation: То есть тропический остров, купание в чистом море, свежие фрукты...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:10.original: Yes! Getting a nice sun tan, too! I'd feel pretty good about a vacation, Mireille!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:10.translation: Да! И красивый загар! Я бы с радостью отправилась в отпуск, Мирей!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:11.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:11.original: Hehe, I'm glad to hear it. Although you're going into a Mysterious Painting, rather than an island.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:11.translation: Хе-хе, рада это слышать. Хотя вы попадёте не на остров, а в Таинственную картину.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:12.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:12.original: I've finally obtained a certain Painting. Its name is "The Treasury at the Sea Bottom."
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:12.translation: Я наконец получила одну картину. Её название — «Сокровищница на дне моря».

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:13.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:13.original: A painting depicting a lovely ocean scene. I thought maybe you could go and have some fun?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:13.translation: Картина с прекрасным морским пейзажем. Подумала, может, сходите и повеселитесь?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:14.original: A vacation in the world inside of a Painting! Heheh, that sounds like fun!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:14.translation: Отдых в мире внутри картины! Хе-хе, звучит весело!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:15.original: The "treasury" part sounds intriguing! We could use all the treasure we can get at the moment!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:15.translation: А вот «сокровищница» звучит интригующе! Сейчас нам пригодились бы любые сокровища!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:16.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:16.original: Good, good. So we can count you both in. We don't need to Restore the Painting this time, either.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:16.translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Значит, вы обе в деле. И на этот раз картину восстанавливать не нужно.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:17.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:17.original: Once you're ready, just come over to the castle. See you later!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:17.translation: Когда будете готовы, просто приходите в замок. До встречи!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:18.original: A vacation! Yes! I don't think we've ever had one of those before!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:18.translation: Отпуск! Да! Кажется, у нас такого ещё никогда не было!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:19.original: I don't think, I know so! Our first ever vacation! Time to have some real fun!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_090.ebm:19.translation: Не «кажется» — я точно знаю! Наш первый отпуск! Пора по-настоящему развлечься!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:0.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:0.original: You're here! This is the setting for your vacation, "The Treasury at the Sea Bottom"!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:0.translation: Вы здесь! Вот место вашего отпуска — «Сокровищница на дне моря»!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:1.original: Wow, it really does look lovely! Is there an ocean like that inside, do you think?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:1.translation: Ого, и правда красиво! Как думаете, внутри есть такое же море?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:2.original: I haven't had a vacation in ages! Hahaha, I'm starting to look forward to this too!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:2.translation: Давно у меня не было отпуска! Ха-ха-ха, я тоже уже жду не дождусь!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:3.original: Me too! I can't wait to kick back and relax!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:3.translation: И я! Не терпится расслабиться и отдохнуть!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:4.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:4.original: Hehehe! I've got my swimsuit all ready. Let's hit the beach!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:4.translation: Хе-хе-хе! Купальник уже готов. На пляж!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:5.original: Off you go then, everyone! Enjoy this little holiday!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_100.ebm:5.translation: Тогда вперёд, все! Наслаждайтесь этим маленьким праздником!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:0.original: The ocean, heaving with raging waves.<CR>Above it flutters the black flag of... UGH?!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:0.translation: Океан, вздымающийся яростными волнами.<CR>Над ним реет чёрный флаг... Э-Э-Э?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:2.original: Blowbling! Blowbling! Blub! Bebeeeelp! Bebeeelp!<CR>(Drowning! Drowning! Retreat, retreat!)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:2.translation: Буууль! Буууль! Буль! Бебеееелп! Бебиееелп!<CR>(Тонем! Тонем! Отступаем, отступаем!)

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:3.original: Oh? You're back sooner than I expected. Did you enjoy your vacation?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:3.translation: Ой? Вы вернулись раньше, чем я ожидала. Понравился отпуск?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:4.original: We didn't even get that far! Gah! I thought I was going to drown in there!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:4.translation: Мы даже далеко не ушли! Гах! Я думала, утону там!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:5.original: I didn't expect the Painting to lead right into the ocean! Ugh, I think I swallowed some!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:5.translation: Я не ожидала, что картина выведет прямо в океан! Уф, кажется, я что-то проглотила!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:6.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:6.original: S-Sorry about that. You can't have a vacation under the ocean, can you, let alone investigate...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:6.translation: П-простите. Под водой в отпуске не побудешь, не говоря уж о том, чтобы что-то исследовать...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:7.original: Hehehe. I wouldn't be so quick to say that!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе-хе. Я бы не торопилась так говорить!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:8.original: Tadah! This is an Air Drop! Putting this in your mouth lets you breathe underwater!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:8.translation: Та-да! Это капля воздуха! Если положить её в рот, можно дышать под водой!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:9.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:9.original: That's crazy! Alchemy continues to trample everything I consider normal...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:9.translation: Это безумие! Алхимия продолжает попирать всё, что я считаю нормальным...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:10.original: Hold on. If you had those on you, why didn't we use them back there?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:10.translation: Погоди. Если они у вас были, почему мы не использовали их там?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:11.original: Indeed, Sue. I knew you'd notice. Actually, I've got something to admit...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:11.translation: Верно, Сью. Я знала, что ты заметишь. Вообще-то мне есть в чём признаться...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:12.original: That's my last Air Drop. I haven't made any of them recently, I'm afraid! Hahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:12.translation: Это моя последняя капля воздуха. Боюсь, в последнее время я их не делала! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:13.original: Ah, I see. In which case, we'll make them. Enough for everyone to use!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:13.translation: Ах, понятно. Тогда мы их сделаем. Хватит на всех!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:14.original: We'll leave that in your hands, then. Here's the last Air Drop and how to make more.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:14.translation: Тогда оставляем это вам. Вот последняя капля воздуха и способ сделать ещё.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:15.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:15.original: We're counting on you. Hurry up, before the vacation fever wears off!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_110.ebm:15.translation: Мы на вас рассчитываем. Поторопитесь, пока отпускная лихорадка не прошла!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:0.original: Right! Air Drops all round! That should be more than enough.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:0.translation: Так! Капель воздуха на всех! Этого должно хватить с лихвой.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:1.original: Great! Now we finally get to enjoy our vacation!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_120.ebm:1.translation: Отлично! Теперь наконец можно насладиться отпуском!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_130.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_130.ebm:0.original: Let's try this again! Vacation time!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_130.ebm:0.translation: Давайте попробуем ещё раз! Время отпуска!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:0.original: The ocean, heaving with raging waves.<CR>Above it flutters the black flag of a pirate vessel.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:0.translation: Океан, вздымающийся бушующими волнами.<CR>Над ним развевается чёрный флаг пиратского судна.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:1.original: In these brigand infested waters, there is known a legend<CR>of one pirate who rose above all others.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:1.translation: В этих кишащих разбойниками водах известна легенда<CR>об одном пирате, что возвысился над всеми остальными.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:2.original: Setting aflame anything in his way, and drowning in riches,<CR>there was one known by the name... Burning Backen.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:2.translation: Поджигая всё на своём пути и утопая в богатствах,<CR>был известен один... Пылающий Бакен.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:3.original: All pirates still seek his most valuable treasures,<CR>hidden somewhere in a cave below the sea waters.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:3.translation: Все пираты до сих пор ищут его самые ценные сокровища,<CR>спрятанные где-то в пещере под морскими водами.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:4.original: The so-called Treasury at the Sea Bottom,<CR>where the great pirate treasure supposedly still slumbers...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_140.ebm:4.translation: Так называемая Сокровищница на дне моря,<CR>где вероятно до сих пор дремлет великое пиратское сокровище...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:0.original: (Wow! We really can breathe in the water now! This is what it's like under the sea?)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:0.translation: (Ого! Теперь мы и правда можем дышать под водой! Вот каково это на морском дне?)

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:1.original: (A fun vacation and loads of treasure await us! Hahaha, I can't wait!)
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_150.ebm:1.translation: (Нас ждут весёлый отпуск и куча сокровищ! Ха-ха-ха, не терпится!)

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:0.original: Phew, we seem to have reached land. Hey, hold on?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:0.translation: Фух, кажется, мы добрались до суши. Эй, погоди?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:1.original: Across the ten seas! Burning all who stand in my way!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:1.translation: Через десять морей! Сжигая всех, кто встанет на пути!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:2.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:2.original: That's the way I do it! Ah, I'm Captain Backen!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:2.translation: Вот так я и поступаю! Ах, я капитан Бакен!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:5.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:5.original: Yes, I think we got that part. May we ask your profession?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:5.translation: Да, эту часть мы уже поняли. Можно узнать вашу профессию?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:6.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:6.original: What? You don't know who I am? Then I'll just have to explain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:6.translation: Что? Вы не знаете, кто я? Тогда придётся объяснить!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:7.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:7.original: I'm Captain Backen! The pirate among pirates, scourge of the ten seas!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:7.translation: Я капитан Бакен! Пират среди пиратов, бич десяти морей!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:8.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:8.original: They call be Burning Backen! You'd do well to remember that, awahahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:8.translation: Меня зовут Пылающий Бакен! Хорошенько это запомните, ава-ха-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:9.original: A p-p-pirate! This is amazing! I've never seen a pirate before!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:9.translation: П-п-пират! Это потрясающе! Я никогда раньше не видела пирата!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:10.original: Me either! He's cooler than I thought! Can we call you Captain? Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:10.translation: И я! Он круче, чем я думала! Можно называть вас капитаном? Капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:11.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:11.original: Awahahaha! Sure you can! You can even join my crew, if you like!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:11.translation: Ава-ха-ха-ха! Конечно! Можете даже вступить в мою команду, если хотите!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:12.original: What? Really? Yes! I'll make a beautiful pirate!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:12.translation: Что? Правда? Да! Из меня выйдет прекрасная пиратка!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:13.original: Me too, me too! I want to wear a hat, an eyepatch, and form the Lydie Pirate Band!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:13.translation: И я, и я! Хочу шляпу, повязку на глаз и создать пиратскую банду Лиди!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:14.original: You two are getting a bit carried away again...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:15.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:15.original: It can't be helped. There's something romantic about the seas, about the word "pirate"... I'll admit that I'm excited too.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:15.translation: Ничего не поделаешь. В морях, в самом слове «пират» есть что-то романтичное... Признаюсь, я тоже воодушевлён.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:16.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:16.original: I know! Meeting a real life pirate? Now all those negotiations finally paid off!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:16.translation: Знаю! Встретить настоящего пирата? Теперь все те переговоры наконец окупились!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:17.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:17.original: Well I'm not going to get swept up in this foolishness! Backen, what are you doing here?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:17.translation: Ну я-то не собираюсь ввязываться в эту глупость! Бакен, что вы здесь делаете?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:18.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:18.original: Where else would I be? This is my treasure-trove! I will defend that treasure, no matter what!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:18.translation: А где ещё мне быть? Это моя сокровищница! Я буду защищать это сокровище, несмотря ни на что!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:19.original: Excuse me! Captain, I have a question! What kind of treasure are we talking about?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:19.translation: Прошу прощения! Капитан, у меня вопрос! О каком сокровище речь?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:20.original: I'd like to know that too! Please tell us, Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:20.translation: Я тоже хочу знать! Расскажите, капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:21.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:21.original: Very well, Minion C, Minion D!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:22.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:22.original: Dare I ask what happened to Minion A and B? Gah, I don't think I can keep up!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:22.translation: Осмелюсь спросить, что случилось с Миньонами А и Б? Гах, не успеваю за вами!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:23.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:23.original: A portrait of a hero, a gold nugget the size of a shoe, and a poem collection to stir the heart!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:23.translation: Портрет героя, золотой самородок размером с ботинок и сборник стихов, что тронет сердце!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:24.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:24.original: The treasures you'll find here are beyond valuation! Awahahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:24.translation: Сокровища, что вы здесь найдёте, неоценимы! Ава-ха-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:26.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:26.original: However, it's been a while since I died. I'm getting tired of defending this treasure alone.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:26.translation: Однако прошло уже много времени с моей смерти. Я устал защищать это сокровище в одиночку.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:27.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:27.original: If you wish, my new minions, I will pass ownership of it on to you.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:27.translation: Если хотите, мои новые миньоны, я передам вам право на него.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:28.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:28.original: Thank you, Captain! We would like that! We would like that very much!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:28.translation: Спасибо, капитан! Мы бы этого хотели! Очень хотели!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:29.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:29.original: A quick change of attitude! Lucia is all about the money, after all.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:29.translation: Вот это смена настроения! В конце концов, Люсия только о деньгах и думает.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:30.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:30.original: Very well! The treasure is stored in my three vaults. You may take whatever you like! Awahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:30.translation: Отлично! Сокровище хранится в трёх моих хранилищах. Берите всё, что захотите! Ава-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:31.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:31.original: Aye-aye, Captain! This feels a little different from a vacation, but no matter!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_160.ebm:31.translation: Есть, капитан! На отпуск это мало похоже, но неважно!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_170.ebm:0.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_170.ebm:0.original: There's no treasure beyond this point. Isn't that what you want?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_170.ebm:0.translation: Дальше сокровищ нет. Разве не этого вы хотите?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:1.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:1.original: Ah, it's my pet Kame-kichi! I haven't seen you for a while. You've gotten pretty big!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:1.translation: А, это мой питомец Каме-кичи! Давно тебя не видел. Ты изрядно вырос!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:2.original: A p-pet? It's cute, but let's ignore it for now.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:2.translation: П-питомец? Милый, но давайте пока его проигнорируем.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:3.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:3.original: We can't. The first vault lies beyond the beast, I'm afraid. You'll have to defeat him to pass.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:3.translation: Нельзя. Боюсь, первое хранилище как раз за зверем. Чтобы пройти, придётся его победить.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:4.original: Come on then, girls! We're here for the treasure, after all!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:4.translation: Тогда вперёд, девочки! Мы ведь здесь ради сокровищ!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:6.original: Let's get our hands on all that gold! For the sake of my ambition, prepare yourself, Kame-kichi!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_180.ebm:6.translation: Давайте заполучим всё это золото! Ради моей амбиции, готовься, Каме-кичи!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:0.original: Phew. Kame-kichi, you were a worthy foe. But we are victorious!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:0.translation: Фух. Каме-кичи, ты был достойным противником. Но победа за нами!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:2.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:2.original: You did a good job defeating Kame-kichi! The treasure here is the portrait of a hero! Tremble!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:2.translation: Отлично справились с Каме-кичи! Сокровище здесь — портрет героя! Трепещите!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:3.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:3.original: Hahaha, this should sell for an incredible amount! Allow me to open it!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:3.translation: Ха-ха-ха, это должно продаться за безумные деньги! Позвольте мне открыть!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:5.original: What is this? A portrait of you, Captain? You're the "hero"?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:5.translation: Что это? Ваш портрет, капитан? Вы и есть «герой»?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:6.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:6.original: That's right! The fire-loving Captain Backen!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:7.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:7.original: Uwah, no way! We won't get a loaf of old bread for this!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:7.translation: Ува, да ну! Нам за это и буханки чёрствого хлеба не дадут!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:8.original: Not to mention, there are loads of the exact same picture scattered about the place!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:8.translation: Не говоря уж о том, что повсюду разбросано множество таких же картинок!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:9.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:9.original: Of course. I needed enough for all my fans! Feel free to take as many as you like.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:9.translation: Конечно. Мне нужно было хватить на всех поклонников! Берите сколько угодно.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:10.original: Yes! Souvenirs for everyone! I'll grab an armful. Aren't you grabbing some too, Lucia?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_200.ebm:10.translation: Да! Сувениры для всех! Я возьму охапку. Люсия, ты тоже возьмёшь?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:1.original: Uwah, that's a large monster! You don't think we can fight that thing, can we...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:1.translation: Ува, это огромный монстр! Вы же не думаете, что мы сможем с ним сразиться...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:2.original: Tell us, Captain. Where's the next treasure vault?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:2.translation: Скажите, капитан. Где следующее хранилище сокровищ?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:3.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:3.original: There! Right where that monster is! That's the second treasure vault!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:3.translation: Там! Прямо там, где этот монстр! Это второе хранилище!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:4.original: What! What's that monster doing there, then?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:4.translation: Что?! Тогда что там делает этот монстр?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:5.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:5.original: I don't know! It must have just taken up residence there. What a pain, honestly! Awahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:5.translation: Не знаю! Должно быть, просто поселился. Какая напасть, честное слово! Ава-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:6.original: What should we do? I don't want to fight that thing, but I also really want that treasure!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:6.translation: Что нам делать? Не хочу с ним драться, но сокровище очень хочется!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:7.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:7.original: I know. Is there any way to get our hands on it without having to fight?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:7.translation: Знаю. Есть способ заполучить его без боя?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:8.original: Hmm. A way without fighting... a-a-achooo!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:9.original: Uwah, Lucia! At least cover your mouth!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:11.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:11.original: Hey, the monster reacted to that noise. If we make an even louder one...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:11.translation: Эй, монстр среагировал на этот шум. Если сделать ещё громче...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:12.original: Maybe we can drive it off? Let's give it a try!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_210.ebm:12.translation: Может, получится его прогнать? Давайте попробуем!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_220.ebm:0.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_220.ebm:0.original: Hey, hey, hey! Watch it! Don't get any closer!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_220.ebm:0.translation: Эй, эй, эй! Осторожнее! Не подходите ближе!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:0.original: Right. Everyone, don't forget to cover your ears. Here we go!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:0.translation: Так. Все, не забудьте заткнуть уши. Поехали!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:2.original: Yes! Just like we planned! It went perfectly, Sophie!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:2.translation: Да! Как мы и планировали! Всё прошло идеально, Софи!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:3.original: I saw it! Well done, Lydie! What do you think is inside that chest?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:3.translation: Видела! Молодец, Лиди! Как думаете, что внутри сундука?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:4.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:4.original: This one contains a nugget of gold as large as a shoe! Prepare yourself well before you open it!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:4.translation: В этом — самородок золота размером с ботинок! Хорошенько подготовьтесь, прежде чем открывать!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:5.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:5.original: Gold! You hear that, everyone? Gold! Enough for us all to be rich! Haha! Hahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:5.translation: Золото! Все слышали? Золото! Хватит, чтобы всем разбогатеть! Ха-ха! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:9.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:9.original: My beloved golden long boots! I guess those years of use have made them a bit fragrant! Awahahaha!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:9.translation: Мои любимые золотые сапоги! Думаю, за годы использования они стали немного... ароматными! Ава-ха-ха-ха!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:10.original: Ugh! Even if they are made of gold, I can't stand this stench!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:10.translation: Фу! Даже если они из золота, эту вонь я не вынесу!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:11.original: Ublaaagh! You wanted this, Lucia, right?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:11.translation: Ублааагх! Ты ведь этого хотела, Люсия?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:12.original: Not any more! They're practically chemical weapons. We'll never sell these stinkers!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:12.translation: Уже нет! Это практически химическое оружие. Этих вонючек мы никогда не продадим!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:13.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:13.original: You will take responsibility for these abominations! That is an order!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:13.translation: Вы возьмёте на себя ответственность за эти мерзости! Это приказ!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:15.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_230.ebm:15.original: The <CLEG>Gold Long Boots<CLNR> were forced upon you...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:0.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:0.original: What's wrong, Captain? Stopping so suddenly!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:0.translation: Что случилось, капитан? Так внезапно остановились!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:1.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:1.original: We're here. The third treasure vault.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:1.translation: Мы на месте. Третье хранилище сокровищ.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:2.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:2.original: Heh, interesting. Rugged, tough. The perfect atmosphere for a pirate.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:2.translation: Хех, интересно. Сурово, жёстко. Идеальная атмосфера для пирата.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:3.original: Tell us, Captain. What treasure can we hope for here?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:3.translation: Скажите, капитан. На какое сокровище здесь можно рассчитывать?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:4.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:4.original: Prepare yourselves! A poem collection to stir the heart! You'll weep as you read, guaranteed!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:4.translation: Готовьтесь! Сборник стихов, что тронет сердце! Гарантирую — будете плакать!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:5.original: The pirate among pirates also has refined literary tastes! I'm impressed, Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:5.translation: У пирата среди пиратов ещё и изысканный литературный вкус! Я впечатлён, капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:6.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:6.original: Awahahaha! Well done, Minion F! I'd appreciate one such as you beside me in the seas!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:6.translation: Ава-ха-ха-ха! Молодец, Миньон Ф! Такого, как ты, я бы с радостью взял с собой в моря!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:7.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:7.original: But here, I cannot allow you to just pass, however. I too... ahem. Anyway!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:7.translation: Но здесь я не могу просто так вас пропустить. Я тоже... кхм. В любом случае!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:8.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:8.original: If you want to come through, bring me some wood! That's the condition!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:8.translation: Если хотите пройти, принесите мне дров! Таково условие!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:9.original: Uwah, very well! But what are you going to use if for?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:9.translation: Ува, хорошо! Но для чего они вам?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:10.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:10.original: To repair my beloved ship. It may never sail again, but I can't bear to see it in such a state.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:10.translation: Починить мой любимый корабль. Возможно, он больше никогда не выйдет в плавание, но я не могу видеть его в таком состоянии.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:11.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:11.original: Captain! A true man of the seas! Still trying to repair your ship, even after your death!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:11.translation: Капитан! Настоящий человек моря! Всё ещё пытаетесь починить корабль даже после смерти!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:12.original: Ah, you've moved me too! Captain! We'll find the wood for you, fear not.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:12.translation: Ах, вы и меня растрогали! Капитан! Мы найдём вам дрова, не сомневайтесь.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:13.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:13.original: Awahaha! Place the wood you've gathered right here. I'm counting on you, my minions!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_240.ebm:13.translation: Ава-ха-ха! Положите собранные дрова прямо сюда. Рассчитываю на вас, мои миньоны!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_250.ebm:0.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_250.ebm:0.original: If you want to pass through here, bring me wood! Otherwise I'll start burning stuff!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_250.ebm:0.translation: Если хотите пройти, принесите мне дров! Иначе начну жечь всё подряд!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:0.original: There we go! Here's the wood you asked for, Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:0.translation: Готово! Вот дрова, которые вы просили, капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:1.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:1.original: Great work. Now I can repair my beloved vessel.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:1.translation: Отличная работа. Теперь я могу починить своё любимое судно.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:2.original: Captain! You fix that beauty up well and good!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:2.translation: Капитан! Почините эту красотку как следует!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:3.original: If there's anything else you need, just let us know. We'll help you however we can.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:3.translation: Если понадобится ещё что-то — просто скажите. Поможем всем, чем сможем.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:4.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:4.original: My deepest thanks, as a man of the sea! You may pass. Pass, read, and weep tears of true emotion!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:4.translation: Моя глубочайшая благодарность как человека моря! Можете пройти. Проходите, читайте и плачьте слезами настоящего умиления!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:5.original: Gulp! I'm not sure I'm ready to be quite this moved! Here we go!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:5.translation: Глоть! Не уверена, что готова быть настолько растроганной! Поехали!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:7.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:7.original: Backen's Burning Hot Poem Notebook! This is what's going to move us so deeply?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:7.translation: Пылающий блокнот со стихами Бакена! Вот что должно нас так глубоко тронуть?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:8.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:8.original: That's right! My greatest work. I'm impressed by your resolve! Go ahead, read!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:8.translation: Верно! Моё величайшее творение. Я впечатлён вашей решимостью! Давайте, читайте!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:9.original: I'm not quite ready. Lucia, you take this one.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:9.translation: Я ещё не готов. Люсия, бери ты.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:10.original: Why me? Very well, then. Aah, OK, here we go...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:10.translation: Почему я? Ну ладно. Ааа, хорошо, поехали...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:11.original: "When fighting my foes I'm always on fire! Like a man made of lava, I roar with desire!..."
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:11.translation: «Сражаясь с врагами, я всегда в огне! Как человек из лавы, реву от желания!...»

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:12.original: I'm sorry, that's all I can take...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:13.original: Hey, don't hand that to me! Uwah! What am I supposed to do with this?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:13.translation: Эй, не передавайте это мне! Ува! Что мне с этим делать?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:14.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:14.original: Awahahaha! Treasure it always, Minion C! If you throw it away, I'll burn you myself!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:14.translation: Ава-ха-ха-ха! Цени это всегда, Миньон С! Выбросишь — сам тебя сожгу!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_260.ebm:15.original: No need for that! I'm keeping it, I'm keeping it!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:0.original: You said there were three vaults, right? That means these are all the treasures?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:0.translation: Вы говорили, хранилищ три, верно? Значит, это все сокровища?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:1.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:1.original: If that's the case, then all of this treasure was junk!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:1.translation: Если так, то всё это сокровище — хлам!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:2.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:2.original: Whatever do you mean, Lucia? If these aren't treasures, I don't know what is!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:2.translation: Что ты имеешь в виду, Люсия? Если это не сокровища, то я и не знаю, что тогда сокровища!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:3.original: Well said, Alt! Lucia, you're being very rude to the Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:3.translation: Верно сказано, Альт! Люсия, ты очень груба с капитаном!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:4.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:4.original: I've no idea what's going on here, honestly! Alright, alright, I'm sorry!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:4.translation: Я понятия не имею, что тут происходит, честно! Ладно, ладно, извините!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:5.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:5.original: Awahaha, no need for that. Just as you said, there's nothing much left...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:5.translation: Ава-ха-ха, не стоит. Как вы и сказали, особо ничего не осталось...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:7.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:7.original: Pay no heed to this old seadog! You did well to collect all three treasures.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:7.translation: Не обращайте внимания на этого старого морского волка! Вы молодцы, что собрали все три сокровища.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:8.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:8.original: Perhaps you are worthy to receive my last and greatest treasure!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:8.translation: Возможно, вы достойны получить моё последнее и величайшее сокровище!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:9.original: Last? Greatest? Am I wrong to get my hopes up?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:9.translation: Последнее? Величайшее? Я зря питаю надежды?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:10.original: Captain, you salty beast! You saved the best for last, right? What is it? What kind of riches await us?!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:10.translation: Капитан, вы солёный зверь! Приберегли лучшее напоследок, да? Что это? Какие богатства нас ждут?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:11.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:11.original: Calm your sails! It lies in a chest in the depths of this place. Come and see for yourselves!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_270.ebm:11.translation: Успокойте паруса! Оно лежит в сундуке в глубине этого места. Идите и убедитесь сами!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:0.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:0.original: Here we are. The treasure sleeps in this chest. Go ahead and open it!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:0.translation: Вот мы и здесь. Сокровище спит в этом сундуке. Давайте, открывайте!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:4.original: Phew. Captain? This chest is locked.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:5.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:5.original: Awahaha, I totally forgot! Fear not, I have the key right here...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:5.translation: Ава-ха-ха, совсем забыл! Не бойтесь, ключ у меня здесь...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:7.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:7.original: Awahaaaaaagh! Broken! What should we do?!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:8.original: Do you even need to ask? Let's smash this chest and grab the goodies inside!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:8.translation: Разве нужно спрашивать? Давайте разобьём сундук и заберём вкусности внутри!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:9.original: Hahaha, personally I don't mind, but somehow I feel like you'll destroy what's inside too.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:9.translation: Ха-ха-ха, лично я не против, но почему-то кажется, что вы уничтожите и содержимое.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:10.original: Alright. If the key is broken, why don't we just fix it?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:10.translation: Ладно. Если ключ сломан, почему бы просто не починить его?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:11.translation: Что? Мы алхимики, а не кузнецы!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:12.original: Doesn't matter! Alchemy can get this job done. I've done it in the past, actually.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:12.translation: Не важно! Алхимия с этим справится. Вообще-то я уже делала такое раньше.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:13.original: Very well. Promise with Mom Number 5, “Don't worry - just do it!”
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:13.translation: Хорошо. Обещание мамы номер пять: «Не волнуйся — просто сделай!»

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:14.original: Well said! Captain? Will you trust us with the remains of that key?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:14.translation: Верно сказано! Капитан? Доверите нам остатки этого ключа?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:15.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:15.original: My marvelous minions! This all takes me back, ah... Very well, this useless key piece is yours.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:15.translation: Мои чудесные миньоны! Всё это навевает воспоминания, ах... Хорошо, этот бесполезный обломок ключа ваш.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:16.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:16.original: The content of this chest is very precious to me, also. I'm counting on you.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_280.ebm:16.translation: Содержимое этого сундука мне тоже очень дорого. Рассчитываю на вас.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:0.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:0.original: Ah, most impressive! The minions have surpassed their teacher! Go ahead and open the chest!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:0.translation: Ах, впечатляет! Миньоны превзошли учителя! Давайте, открывайте сундук!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:1.original: Right! Finally, we get some real treasure!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:2.original: Good, the key worked. Time to unveil the Captain's secret treasure!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:2.translation: Хорошо, ключ сработал. Пора раскрыть тайное сокровище капитана!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:3.original: What is this? A pistol? It looks pretty old. But...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:3.translation: Что это? Пистолет? Выглядит довольно старым. Но...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:4.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:4.original: Indeed it is. That's my very first pistol. Awahaha, just looking brings out so many memories...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:4.translation: Именно так. Это мой самый первый пистолет. Ава-ха-ха, один взгляд — и столько воспоминаний...

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:6.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:6.original: That's right. I braved the ten seas with that pistol at my hip.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:6.translation: Верно. С этим пистолетом на бедре я бороздил десять морей.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:7.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:7.original: I've pillaged many mighty treasures, but doing so always required more bloodshed.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:7.translation: Я награбил много великих сокровищ, но для этого всегда требовалось ещё больше крови.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:8.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:8.original: Once you have the treasures, too, people fight you to take them. And thus, here I am, with nothing.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:8.translation: А когда сокровища уже у тебя, люди сражаются, чтобы их отнять. И вот я здесь — ни с чем.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:10.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:10.original: Days spent singing, talking, sailing with my crew. This pistol was there for all those fun times.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:10.translation: Дни песен, разговоров и плавания с командой. Этот пистолет был рядом во все те весёлые времена.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:11.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:11.original: That's what makes it my greatest treasure. Even if it's just junk to you.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:11.translation: Вот что делает его моим величайшим сокровищем. Даже если для вас это просто хлам.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:12.original: Not at all. Regardless of the material value, a treasure is a treasure. Right Minion... girls?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:12.translation: Нисколько. Независимо от материальной ценности, сокровище остаётся сокровищем. Верно, Миньон... девочки?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:13.original: She's right, Captain! Thank you so much for showing us this incredible treasure!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:13.translation: Она права, капитан! Огромное спасибо, что показали нам это невероятное сокровище!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:14.original: Keeping your first pistol for all these years! Captain, you're just incredible!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:14.translation: Хранить первый пистолет все эти годы! Капитан, вы просто невероятны!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:15.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:15.original: Awahaha! I think you are worthy of my greatest treasure, then!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:15.translation: Ава-ха-ха! Тогда, думаю, вы достойны моего величайшего сокровища!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:16.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:16.original: Accept it and go, my dear minions! Use this pistol to bring the world to its knees!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:16.translation: Примите его и ступайте, мои дорогие миньоны! Используйте этот пистолет, чтобы поставить мир на колени!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:17.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:17.original: Raaagh! The manliness!! I can feel the love of the sea coursing through my veins, Captain!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:17.translation: Раааагх! Мужественность!! Чувствую, как любовь к морю течёт по моим венам, капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:18.original: I need to look after old artifacts better myself.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:18.translation: Мне самой нужно лучше ухаживать за старыми артефактами.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:19.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:19.original: Awahahaha! I'm happy to have met you all!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:19.translation: Ава-ха-ха-ха! Рад, что встретил вас всех!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:21.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:21.original: Awahaha! Pirates always wear a grin, missy! Weep not for our parting, and become a fine pirate!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:21.translation: Ава-ха-ха! Пираты всегда улыбаются, милая! Не плачьте о расставании и станьте прекрасными пиратками!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:22.speaker: Backen
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:22.original: Never forget how it felt at the start of your adventure! Blessing of the seas to you all!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:22.translation: Никогда не забывайте, каково это было в начале приключения! Благословение морей всем вам!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:24.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:24.original: We had a lot of fun with you, Captain. Thank you.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:24.translation: Нам было очень весело с вами, капитан. Спасибо.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:27.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:27.original: Aaah... Oh, look. Color Fragments, where the Captain was standing!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:27.translation: Ааа... О, смотри. Цветные фрагменты там, где стоял капитан!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:28.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:28.original: Hehe. A thank you gift from him, surely. He was happy we spent this time with him.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:28.translation: Хе-хе. Наверняка благодарственный подарок от него. Он был рад, что мы провели с ним это время.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:29.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:29.original: I think you're right. Thank you, Captain... We won't forget the things you taught us.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:29.translation: Думаю, ты права. Спасибо, капитан... Мы не забудем то, чему вы нас научили.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:32.speaker: System
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_290.ebm:32.original: Sue has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Competitor's Prize"<CLNR>.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:0.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:0.original: Ah, welcome back! How was your vacation?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:0.translation: Ах, с возвращением! Как прошёл отпуск?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:1.original: Ah! I totally forgot we were meant to be vacationing! It didn't really turn out that way.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:1.translation: Ах! Я совсем забыла, что мы должны были отдыхать! На деле всё вышло совсем иначе.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:2.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:2.original: It didn't? I'm really sorry about that.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:3.original: Not at all! It was a lot of fun. Thank you for setting this up for us!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:3.translation: Нисколько! Было очень весело. Спасибо, что устроили это для нас!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:4.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:4.original: It was? Then I'm glad you enjoyed it. I've got some good news for you, too.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:4.translation: Правда? Тогда рада, что вам понравилось. У меня для вас тоже хорошие новости.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:5.original: The continuation of the Atelier Ranking System has been officially approved! How about a little applause?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:5.translation: Продолжение системы рангов ателье официально одобрено! Как насчёт небольших аплодисментов?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:6.original: It has? Yes! Now we can aim to become the greatest in the kingdom once again!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:6.translation: Одобрено? Да! Теперь снова можно стремиться стать лучшими в королевстве!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:7.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:7.original: But how come? I thought the system had served its purpose?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:7.translation: Но почему? Я думала, система уже выполнила свою задачу?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:8.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:8.original: That's true, but I explained how developing alchemy will lead to further financial wealth.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:8.translation: Это правда, но я объяснила, как развитие алхимии приведёт к дальнейшему финансовому процветанию.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:9.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:9.original: Adalet has ignored alchemy until now. If we change that, our kingdom can continue to grow.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:9.translation: До сих пор в Адалете алхимию игнорировали. Если это изменить, королевство сможет расти и дальше.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:10.original: Hmm, I see. You've given this some thought, haven't you?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:10.translation: Хм, понятно. Вы всё это обдумали, не так ли?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:11.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:11.original: You bet I have! We're going to let other alchemists into the Mysterious Paintings, too.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:11.translation: Ещё как! Мы собираемся допустить к Таинственным картинам и других алхимиков.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:12.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:12.original: Let's all work together to make our kingdom an even better place to live!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:12.translation: Давайте все вместе сделаем наше королевство ещё лучше!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:13.original: Count us in, of course! Ah, we need to tell dad about this right away!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:13.translation: Конечно, мы с вами! Ах, нужно срочно рассказать об этом папе!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:14.original: Come on, then! See you all later!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:15.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:15.original: Sis. Shouldn't you tell them the other reason? You made a big point of it during the discussions.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:15.translation: Сестра. Разве не стоит рассказать им и о другой причине? Ты так на этом настаивала на обсуждениях.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:16.speaker: Mathias
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:16.original: The twins are working so hard to increase their rank... Adults shouldn't destroy children's dreams, right?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:16.translation: Близняшки так стараются повысить ранг... Взрослые не должны рушить детские мечты, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:17.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:17.original: Dreams are a vital part of life. Working toward a dream is when people evolve the most.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:17.translation: Мечты — важная часть жизни. Стремясь к мечте, люди развиваются сильнее всего.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:18.original: Hahaha, well said, Mireille. I think that's a lovely sentiment.
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:18.translation: Ха-ха-ха, верно сказано, Мирей. Думаю, это прекрасная мысль.

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:19.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:19.original: Don't tell the twins about this, though. It will make working with them a lot harder!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:19.translation: Но не говорите об этом близняшкам. Иначе с ними будет куда труднее работать!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:20.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:20.original: Yes, yes, I won't say a word. Those two are very loved, aren't they?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_300.ebm:20.translation: Да-да, ни слова. Этих двоих очень любят, правда?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:1.original: What, he's still not back? Hold on, look. A note and some money?
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:1.translation: Что, он всё ещё не вернулся? Погоди, смотри. Записка и немного денег?

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:2.speaker: Roger
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:2.original: "My dear girls. I won't be back for a while. Use this money for food. Roger."
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:2.translation: «Мои дорогие девочки. Меня какое-то время не будет. Используйте эти деньги на еду. Роджер».

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:3.original: He won't be back for a while? What does that mean? Sue! We need to go and look for him!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:3.translation: Его какое-то время не будет? Что это значит? Сью! Нужно идти его искать!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:4.original: Right away! I don't want Dad to go off somewhere on his own, no way!
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:4.translation: Сейчас же! Не хочу, чтобы папа уходил куда-то один, ни за что!

ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:5.original: We searched the whole city, but we couldn't find him anywhere...
ebm:mm07/event_message_mm07_310.ebm:5.translation: Мы обыскали весь город, но нигде его не нашли...
